## What it is

Working with a team of data science soccer students and my advisor, this research project aimed to analyze two seasons of Willamette men's soccer match data to provide coaching staff data-driven insights for tactical adjustments and season tracking.

## What I did

- Served as the primary data analysis and integration lead, developing end-to-end R pipelines to collect, clean, and structure match data for team and opponent-level performance analysis
- Designed and deployed an interactive Shiny dashboard integrating season-long and opponent-specific analytics, giving coaching staff real-time access to tactical insights throughout the season

## Outputs
